fixes: Use Wilder smoothing for RSI and ATR.
Require 50 valid candles and use the same SMA50 value in trend classification.
Reject malformed OHLC candles and non-positive prices.
Validate capital, risk, fee, and candle-count settings.
Add a 15-second network timeout, clearer fetch errors, and clear stale results after a failed refresh.
Cap estimated order value by available capital including estimated entry fee; risk sizing also includes approximate entry and stop fees.
Label the stop estimate as long-only.
limitations: Network data retrieval and CORS were not tested against live Binance from a real browser or the user's device.
Mocked and synthetic data do not prove strategy profitability.
Position sizing does not enforce exchange lot sizes, tick size, minimum notional, slippage, spread, rounding, or account-specific fee tiers.
No full historical backtest on real market data was run.
